name: pr-author
description: Act as the author of a Buddy pull request: open a PR from the current branch with `bdy pr create` (optionally after making and committing the change), or address review feedback – fix the code, push, and answer and resolve the review threads. Use when the user asks to open, create or "załóż" a pull request, to make a change and open a PR with it, or to fix / respond to review comments on their PR. Not for reviewing a PR (use pr-review) or only showing one (use the buddy skill).
